outline:
本課程內容含有: (1)簡介。(2)光電能源物理(3)太陽能電池材料與原理(4)光電化學能源技術(5)儲能材料與元件(6)先進能源材料分析技術(optional)
The class includes :1.Course Introduction, 2.solar energy,3. solar cell materials and devices 4. photo-electrochemical reactions for energy harvesting,5. energy storage technology, 6. advanced characterization tools for energy material research
schedule:
1. introduction
2. fundamental physics of energy materials
3. photovoltaic materials
4. nano materials and nano science for energy application
5. fundamental of electrochemistry for energy application
6. mid term exam.
7. artificial photosynthesis (solar to fuel)
8. energy storage (batteries)
9. hydrogen energy: hydrogen generation and storage
10.advanced characterization tools for energy material research
11. final report

flexible_learning.content:
先進材料最新研究文獻研讀，學生需閱讀近五年國際期刊一篇之研究論文，分析材料設計理念、製程技術、特性及應用，並整理成書面報告繳交。
以下為建議期刊：Nature Energy, Nature Materials, Nature Physics, Nature Photonics, Nature Nanotechnology, Energy & Environmental Science, Journal of Materials Chemistry A, Science, Science Advances, Nano Letters, JACS, ACS Nano, ACS Energy Letters,  ACS Materials Letters, Advanced Materials, Advanced Energy Materials, Advanced Functional Materials, Advanced Science, Progress in Materials Science, Materials Today.
flexible_learning.outcome: 培養文獻閱讀、資料分析、科學表達及獨立思考能力，提升對能源材料與應用最新研究發展之理解。
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: 書面報告視為一次作業

assessment:
report 40%
mid term exam 30%
final exam 30%
